proxy.note: Costs more: isp 0.30 credits, residential 0.60 (plain page 0.15). Use only for a site that blocked a plain request, and try isp before residential.

country.note: Two-letter exit country for isp or residential, e.g. us, gb. A country without isp addresses is served through residential at 0.60.

parse.note: true for all, or pick {links, media, metadata, tables}

timeout.note: Seconds, 5 to 120: answer within this time. Send a little less than your client's limit (25 for a 30 s client): the answer is the page, 403 blocked or 504 timeout, never a dropped call. Neither failure is charged.
